sections.name: Navbar
sections.description: Sticky marketing nav on a blurred page-tone veil: gradient-tile wordmark, journey-organised links, ghost sign-in plus one orange CTA, and a mobile menu that swaps in under 760px. Slim variant strips the nav to Pricing plus a single CTA for conversion pages; transparent variant sits over a hero.

usedBy.note: Sticky mega-menu with a single primary CTA
Mega-nav organized by buyer-journey stage and role, not product list
Nav grouped by lifecycle verbs: Channels / Build / Optimize / Scale
Persona/Roles menu as a first-class nav category
Persona switcher and theme toggle inside the marketing nav

sections.name: Announcement banner
sections.description: One-line dismissible strip above the nav for launches, offers, events and waitlists. Gradient variant is the page's loud brand moment; subtle variant is a quiet sunken bar with an optional New badge for routine product news.

usedBy.note: Gated benchmark report promo, lead capture from the very top
Acquisition notice with CEO quote inline, not just a link
Waitlist funnel for an unreleased product

sections.name: Interior page header
sections.description: Interior page opener: breadcrumb trail, eyebrow chip, display headline and a one-line value sub. Left-aligned variant for pricing-style pages; blog-post variant swaps the sub for author, date, read-time and category metadata.

usedBy.note: Blog title plus one-line value tagline; category nav doubles as blog IA
Title, tagline and a category chip row
Centered blog header with category chips

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: The footer as sitemap: brand column with tagline and a one-field newsletter form, auto-fitting link columns, then a legal and social bar. Fat is the default grammar of the sweep; minimal collapses to one link row for lean pages; legal-only is the utility strip for sunset and legal pages.

usedBy.note: Massive footer as sitemap, enabling a radically short page
Fat footer carries the full IA the sparse page deliberately avoids
Free-tools column doubles as SEO and lead-gen surface
Compare column plus a live status line
